description: This Java class 'ProductPriceUtils' provides utility functions for handling product pricing, including price retrieval, final price calculations considering attributes and discounts, formatting amounts with currency for display, validating and parsing monetary strings, and checking for discounts on product prices within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductPriceUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling product pricing calculations, formatting, and validation.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the default price of a Product from its availabilities.

methods.name: getFinalProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product including additional attributes with positive prices.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Gets the final price for a product, considering default attributes and discounts.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a raw string suitable for admin input, e.g., '1,299.99'.

methods.name: getStoreFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with store's currency and locale, either in national or international format.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with a specified currency and locale.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with store's currency for admin display.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats amount with currency, using a Currency object.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats amount with currency considering store, amount, and locale.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a string amount into BigDecimal, handling various currency formats and validation.

methods.name: getOrderProductTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates total price for an OrderProduct taking quantity into account.

methods.name: hasDiscount
methods.description: Checks if a ProductPrice has an active discount based on current date and discount period.
